hypotheses.H1: mean paired R_net = mean(R_true - R_decoy) > 0 on top-decile captions (bootstrap CI + sign-flip permutation p)
hypotheses.H3_exploratory: dose response of R and per-token E across full/half/3-word hints (direction reported, no threshold claim)

design.instrument: gemma2-full-nll (certified); protocol identical to mesh_signals.compute_signals base/framed measurements
design.decoy: another selected contest's uncanny description (seeded derangement)
design.caption_arms: top and bottom decile by crowd mean (votes >= 40, integrity-screened) — a deliberate outcome-conditioned contrast
design.leak_rule: exclude items with frame-caption novel-word overlap > 0.4

power.formula: MDE(95%) ~= 1.96 * SD(paired R_net) / sqrt(n); observed SD is filled post-hoc and the criterion CAN fire iff CI excludes 0

preregistration.family: H1 and H2 are the confirmatory family (2 tests, reported without correction as two pre-registered primary/secondary); H3 is exploratory

plan_summary.mapping_note: jmhessel 1..705 index bridged to real contest numbers via unique-normalized finalist captions; unanimous votes only

truth_boundary.verified: surprisal collapse of the certified instrument under trusted HUMAN-authored frames, net of seeded decoys, with a pre-registered paired design
truth_boundary.not_verified: human comprehension, funniness, or generalization beyond this publication's cartoons; the top/bottom contrast conditions on the crowd mean by design; scene descriptions are annotators' text, not the drawing itself

data_note: caption and scene text are research-only; aggregates and hashes only in this receipt — row-level values stay in the research-tree checkpoint

plan_change.cause: host load average ~50-60 (unrelated concurrent workloads) tripled per-call instrument latency mid-run; truncated at a completed-contest boundary
plan_change.method: contests are the FIRST N of a deterministic sha256 ordering, so the analyzed set is the exact deterministic prefix of the original plan (no outcome-dependent selection); base/true/dose measurements are the original checkpointed values
plan_change.decoy_note: the decoy derangement is a function of the analyzed-set size, so decoy arms were re-measured under the final n=34 derangement (design lesson: pin decoy assignment to item identity, not set size)
plan_change.consequence: MDE at n=34 is larger than planned (see preregistration.power); criteria can still fire iff CIs exclude zero
